result.topic_en: Page of bare calculations: at the top a formula involving a sum of logarithms and log-integrals (apparently prime-number/zeta related); the rest contains kinematic equations for a rotating fluid ellipsoid with direction cosines, time derivatives of the semi-axes a, b, c, and angular velocity components u, v, w, u_1, v_1, w_1.
